notes_for_editor: PROTECTED DATA, decide before publishing: the record's built year (1982), height (2.0 m), elevation (2049.5 m), Cabin type, fly-in access, the closed access level and the staffed March to October and please-do-not-visit notes all come only from the Alberta WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT layer (cached at data/raw/expansion/prairies-north/ab_wf_wildfire_lookout_attrs.json). Its metadata (ab_lookout_layer0_meta.json) gives the security classification as Protected and says the features are not to be displayed on maps the general public will see. None of those values is in the story or facts. Whether this lookout may appear publicly at all is the editor's call. NO PUBLIC SOURCE for build date, builder, staffing, the structure's condition today, or whether the site is open. The only site source is a single 2014 hiker's trip report (March 15, 2014), which describes a bushwhack and a big fire lookout structure with a helicopter pad on the summit (as of 2014). An earlier draft of the story said the report mentioned no building; that was wrong and is corrected at fact-check 2026-10-20. The report's route directions are left out on purpose, since the site's access is unconfirmed. Confidence low; consider holding the story until an official source turns up.
